title: Human Preferences for Constructive Interactions in Language Model Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Moderation analysis using mixed-effects Bayesian regression to evaluate how user age (under vs. over 45) influences human preference scores for LLM response attributes like toxicity and personal storytelling.
Moderation analysis using mixed-effects Bayesian regression to evaluate how user gender (male vs. non-male) influences human preference scores for various LLM response attributes.
Moderation analysis using mixed-effects Bayesian regression to evaluate how user ethnicity (white vs. non-white) influences human preference scores for LLM response attributes.

Moderation analysis using mixed-effects Bayesian regression to evaluate how users' emphasis on whether AI should reflect their personal values or cultural perspectives influences their preference scores for LLM responses.
